description: 3X-UI: web panel for Xray-core with multi-user inbounds (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, Hysteria, TUIC, MASQUE, MTProto, AmneziaWG), traffic and expiry limits, subscriptions, a Telegram bot and multi-node management. Xray, mtg-multi and the geo files come from their own gesu packages.
notes: Scoop Apps: '3X-UI' starts the panel in a console window; it runs while the window stays open.
Panel: http://localhost:2053/ by default. On the very first start the log prints a random user name and password, once.
Lost them? Stop the panel, then: 3x-ui setting -username NAME -password PASS. '3x-ui setting -show' prints port and path.
Database, logs and the panel's bin folder are kept across updates in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\3X-UI (data, log, bin).
On each start the 3x-ui command copies Xray, mtg-multi and the geo files into bin from their gesu packages, so
'scoop update' updates them; an Xray version or geo file the panel downloads itself is replaced again on the next start.
Iran and Russia geo files: scoop install gesu/Chocolate4U-Iran-v2ray-rules gesu/runetfreedom-russia-v2ray-rules-dat
(until then the copies from the 3X-UI release are used).
Windows Firewall asks on the first start: allow 3x-ui.exe and Xray for the networks clients connect from.
fail2ban (IP limit) and the bash menu (x-ui) exist only on Linux.
pre_install: # A fresh install stops if a 3X-UI panel, its Xray or its mtg-multi is running anywhere, or the database is open
# (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1): a second panel would fight over port 2053. Updates are checked in pre_uninstall.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { error "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; break }

if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Stop the panel (Ctrl+C in its window) and close anything holding its database open, then try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")`nScoop has already put $app into its app folder: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."; break }
# The release's own copies of Xray, mtg and the geo files stay as a fallback: Start-3XUI.ps1 uses them only for
# a component whose package is not installed. 'bin' itself is the persisted folder the panel runs from.
# OpenSSL comes as an installer here; gesu/OpenSSL-Light is the same tool without running it.
# The 3x-ui command and the 3X-UI shortcut (see the package page).
if ($missing) { error "$(Split-Path -Leaf $missing[0]) is missing from the bucket: install with 'scoop install gesu/3X-UI'."; break }
pre_uninstall: # 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall' stop here, before anything is removed, while the panel runs
# Without the helper (e.g. the bucket was removed) only warn: uninstalling must stay possible.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { warn "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; return }
if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Stop the panel (Ctrl+C in its window) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
